effects.effect: Your god blesses your flesh and infuses it with divine quickness. You gain a +1 bonus to speed and to the [distance](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) you can [shift](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) when you take the [Disengage](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.move-actions/disengage) move action.
